newsitem.title: UK: LPC- Akzo Nobel seeks $1 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC- Akzo Nobel seeks $1 bln loan.

text.p: LONDON, September 19 (LPC) - Chemicals to pharmaceuticals company Akzo Nobel has given ABN AMRO Bank and Union Bank of Switzerland a mandate to arrange a $1 billion syndicated loan.

The credit, launched into general syndication Tuesday, is a seven-year revolver. Pricing is 15 basis points over LIBOR with a 7.5 bps commitment fee. Drawings in excess of 50 percent are subject to a 2.5 bps utilisation fee.
Akzo Nobel will use the funds to refinance a $700 million credit from 1994. That deal, also of seven years, was priced 22.5 bps over LIBOR with a 12 bps commitment fee.
